CLIP (with atom IDs): E14.019 | 00:31.00-00:34.00 | CAM | Close-up on the widow's hands gripping the rail.
E14.020 | 00:31.20-00:34.00 | ACT | the widow draws a short blade from a boot.
E14.021 | 00:31.40-00:33.80 | DLG | CORIN (cold, dry) | "Say her name again and you will regret it."
E14.022 | 00:34.00-00:38.00 | CAM | Low angle on the widow framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.023 | 00:34.40-00:37.06 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (nervous, cold) | "The council has already decided her fate."
E14.024 | 00:38.00-00:41.00 | CAM | Close-up on Mara's hands gripping the rail.
E14.025 | 00:41.00-00:46.00 | CAM | Close-up on Corin's jaw tightening.
E14.026 | 00:46.00-00:48.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E14.027 | 00:48.00-00:53.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Corin and Selene, the space between them charged.
E14.028 | 00:48.40-00:51.06 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (cold, triumphant) | "The council has already decided her fate."
E14.029 | 00:53.00-00:58.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Selene toward Corin.
E14.030 | 00:53.20-00:58.00 | ACT | Corin grabs Selene by the wrist.
E14.031 | 00:53.40-00:57.58 | DLG | CORIN (dry, protective) | "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
E14.032 | 00:58.00-01:02.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.
E14.033 | 00:58.40-01:01.44 | DLG | MARA (defiant, broken) | "Is this mercy, or is it another trap?"
E14.034 | 01:02.00-01:07.00 | CAM | Close-up on Tobin's hands gripping the rail.
E14.035 | 01:02.20-01:07.00 | ACT | Tobin grabs Mara by the wrist.
E14.036 | 01:02.40-01:05.06 | DLG | SELENE (sweet, cruel) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
E14.037 | 01:07.00-01:13.00 | CAM | Low angle on Mara framed against the lighthouse beam.
E14.038 | 01:07.40-01:09.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (pompous, nervous) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
